name: National Child Neurology Tele-Helpline
description: Information on childhood neurodevelopment. The Government’s DEPwD directory lists this service for questions about autism symptoms in children.
availability: Listed by DEPwD as a 24/7 service.

name: National Disability Information Helpline
description: Information on disabilities, UDID services, education, government schemes and support services across India.
availability: Automated information is available round the clock; call attendants are available during working hours.

name: Nayi Disha Helpline
description: Family information and support resources for intellectual disabilities. Listed in the Government’s DEPwD helpline directory.
availability: Check current availability directly with Nayi Disha.
